title: John Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on the conversation with Nicodemus and John the Baptist's testimony in John 3.

questions.explanation: There was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.

answers.text: A Pharisee and a ruler of the Jews

questions.text: When did Nicodemus come to Jesus?
questions.explanation: This man came to Jesus by night and said that no one could do the signs Jesus did unless God was with him.

questions.text: What did Jesus say a person must be to see the kingdom of God?
questions.explanation: Unless one is born anew, he can't see the kingdom of God.

answers.text: A keeper of the whole law

questions.text: What question did Nicodemus ask about being born again?
questions.explanation: Nicodemus asked how a man can be born when he is old, and whether he can enter a second time into his mother's womb.

answers.text: Where does the Spirit come from
How can a man be born when he is old

questions.text: To what did Jesus compare the Spirit?
questions.explanation: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but you don't know where it comes from or where it goes; so is everyone who is born of the Spirit.

questions.text: What did Moses lift up in the wilderness, as a picture of the Son of Man being lifted up?
questions.explanation: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up.

questions.text: Which verse says God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son?
questions.explanation: For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

questions.text: Why did God send his Son into the world, according to John 3:17?
questions.explanation: God didn't send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.

answers.text: To save the world through him

questions.text: Where was John the Baptist baptizing in this chapter?
questions.explanation: John also was baptizing in Aenon near Salim, because there was much water there.

questions.text: What did John the Baptist say about Jesus and himself?
questions.explanation: He must increase, but I must decrease.

answers.text: I will build the temple again
He must increase, but I must decrease
